text.content: Commit 207246a5e06c7c3219c78c5eb61fd5266bde3a36 passed 72 focused tests and a B200 BF16 smoke test. However, identical 2048-sample action loss was aligned 0.0082494505, zero 0.0082474817, and shuffle 0.0082493899, so aligned memory did not outperform either intervention.
